registryBasis: The Guangxi Natural Resources Department's official 2024 cadastral-guidance page lists 梧州市自然资源局 (Wuzhou Natural Resources Bureau) as the municipal natural-resources authority and describes cadastral databases, cadastral-unit identifiers, and cadastral-map visualization/query work. This evidences a local statutory custodian, not an open parcel-data integration.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: 广西壮族自治区自然资源厅 / Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Department of Natural Resources
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official guidance says cadastral work is organized by municipal/county natural-resources bureaus, uses the real-estate-unit code as identifier, and promotes cadastral-data and cadastral-map visualization. It links the official Wuzhou bureau and Guangxi Tianditu portals.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Read official guidance. It identifies Wuzhou's municipal bureau and describes cadastral identifiers/database and visualization goals; it does not return parcel geometry.
Official directory/search lead timed out during fetch; search-result text still exposed the Wuzhou bureau link and Guangxi platform links. No inference of absence was made.
Request stopped at normal TLS verification. No login, credentials, private token, or certificate exception was used.
Bounded string/configuration inspection found no exposed cadastral, parcel, 地籍, 宗地, or anonymous ID-plus-geometry request route.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.status: Search result retrieved; direct fetch timed out
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official announcement was reviewed from indexed result text. It requires identity authentication for visual queries and does not expose a safe anonymous geometry response.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Wuzhou municipal custodian lead, Guangxi cadastral guidance, Guangxi public map shell/current JavaScript, and official online-registration announcement reviewed.

geometryDecision: No GeoJSON retained. No qualifying anonymous official response containing a safe native parcel identity plus unchanged geometry was available. The exact WUP point was not used to infer absence.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel/cadastral identity if publicly exposed
remainingUncertainty: A local statutory custodian is evidenced, but the Wuzhou portal could not be inspected under normal TLS and no anonymous parcel endpoint, schema, CRS, exact-point inclusion, or citywide machine-readable coverage was verified. The Guangxi authenticated visual-query program and map shell do not establish open parcel-service availability or citywide absence.
nextStep: A serial reviewer should independently check the Wuzhou bureau portal after its TLS configuration is repaired or through a separately published official route, and qualify a geometry-only sample before any adapter consideration.
